title: Engage with Category Teams with Defined Business Case

contentBody.description: Now that you have key information from your customer on the business problem, desired outcome, and roadblocks, its time to engage the experts.

sections.content:
The next step is connecting with the experts on who to engage and bring into you team to help you build you customer's solution on Gaudi. Send an email to below to Megan Gawlik to discuss ecosystem routes to market with Gaudi. Use the below as a guide to send your email and begin the conversation on the best route to solution and eventually POC and deployment.

To: Megan Gawlik
CC: Category Teams engaged after your Gaudi Fit Questionnaire Qualified
Subject: Gaudi Opportunity with [Customer Name]

Information to Include:
  • Customer Name
  • Customer Business Challenge
  • Customer's solution requirements
  • Customer's preferred OEM if on-prem / hybrid
  • Any additional details on the opportunity that are important to understand
